propositions: E2 builds a deterministic seeded-defect mutant corpus with five defect classes (absent capability, layer-cake split, consumed-artifact-without-ordering, unnecessary mechanism, untagged operational AC) from real cleanly-closed plans to measure gate detection power with known ground truth.

The benchmark harness (assemble_e2_mutants.py, run_e2_benchmark.py, e2_counting.py) implements store isolation via standalone git clone and run-validity guards (≥0.20 INDETERMINATE cap) with golden unit tests.

The expensive ~100-run LLM batch baseline sweep over the corpus is permanently rejected on cost; detection/blocking-FP signal is superseded by d8a5's standing criterion_effectiveness.py recorder (change #798) accumulating signal from production reviews at $0 marginal cost.
History-mining for baseline reconstruction is dead because only ~4 plan-v3 sidecar baselines exist against ~200 needed after the impact_model_version bump stranded historical data.

The deterministic half (mutant corpus, thresholds, harness seams, counting helpers, golden tests) is designed and built as WIP on branch calib/6982-e2 but intentionally NOT landed on main since the harness only exists to drive the rejected batch.

E1's finding-adjudication TP/FP corpus was invalidated (tool-less, plan-truncated labeling not matching whole-plan production gate); E2 derives ground truth by construction from seeded mutations and consumes only E1's valid outcome corpus.
